data.title: Spring Update: Play For Free Until May 2!
data.summary: Check out the Wild Ten for free!
data.content:
Grow your power in the Spring Update, now live in War Robots: Frontiers. Whether you’re a Pioneer or a new Pilot, invite your friends and play for free until May 2!

PLAY FOR FREE 

If you’ve not experienced the Wild Ten yet, you can try out this update and the full War Robots: Frontiers Early Access experience for free now until May 2 via MY.GAMES Launcher or the free Demo Version on Steam.

The Spring Update included the first Progress Wipe. All accounts have had their progress reset, so all Pilots can enjoy the coming battles on equal footing. 

NEW ROBOTS: OROCHI AND PURIFIER

Pilot two brand-new Robots in the Spring Update, each with their own unique Ability.

  • Orochi:  Orochi highlights enemies, pings them, and prepares for a team fight with its allies using its Spotlight ability.
  • Purifier: Purifier keeps its allies close, buffing them as they head into battle with its Zealot ability.

NEW MAP: CATALYST

Watch your step—the new volcanic map has more to worry about than just your enemies! Battle on the new Catalyst Map, where lava can take you out just as fast as a foe. 

NEW WEAPONS & ABILITIES

  • New Weapon - Rampant: Cause major AoE damage with this light grenade launcher. 
  • New Weapon - Incinerator: Burn up the competition with this new flamethrower.
  • New Ability - Minefield: Slow enemies and inflict damage with this new Ability.

NEW FEATURES

  • Firing Range: Test out your Robot and Titan builds on the new Firing Range!
  • Titan Constructor: Upgrade and customize your fearsome friends in the new Titan Constructor. 

Check out the patch notes for a full list of new features and changes in the Spring Update!

JOIN THE WAR ROBOTS COMMUNITY!

Subscribe to the official newsletter to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on Twitter and Facebook, and join the official Discord server. You can also wishlist and follow War Robots: Frontiers on Steam to get the latest news there.
